title: 音樂工作室
intro: 與智能體一起創作音樂。你和智能體都驅動同一個無介面音樂引擎。

msg.sampleImported: Sample imported and placed on the timeline.

tracks.title: 音軌
tracks.empty: 尚無音軌。產生範例節拍以開始。

recording.title: Recording
recording.status: Microphone, line-in, comping, and take lanes will live here once the audio-device bridge is wired.

tuning.title: Tune
tuning.subtitle: Analyze pitch and plan key-aware vocal/instrument correction.

beat.title: Beat maker
beat.status: Step sequencing, sample chopping, swing, and humanization belong in this lane.

mixer.title: Mixer
mixer.subtitle: Balance track volume, pan, mute/solo, inserts, and master routing.

producer.title: AI producer
producer.brief: The agent should listen to the session, understand harmony, timing, tone, and mix balance, then make producer-grade edits when asked.
producer.taskAnalyze: Analyze melody, chord movement, rhythm, and emotional direction.
producer.taskTune: Tune vocals or instruments while preserving natural expression.
producer.taskMix: Balance levels, EQ, compression, stereo width, and loudness.
producer.taskArrange: Suggest structure, transitions, drops, fills, and final polish.

projects.subtitle: Create, open, and manage local .daw sessions.

playlist.subtitle: Arrange pattern, MIDI, audio, and automation clips on the song timeline.

pianoRoll.subtitle: Write chords, melodies, note lengths, and velocity for MIDI tracks.

browser.subtitle: Import WAV samples and manage audio used by this project.
